subject: research/sensing-gatecorr
professional: a senior multi-view geometry / structure-from-motion researcher (geometric verification and robust bundle adjustment); first checks: does the corrupted-observation rate really match the stated rate in every cell, is the 8-point fit and Sampson gate textbook-correct, is the correlated-mismatch model geometrically meaningful or an artefact, are the comparisons paired and given uncertainty, and is the repeated-structure SfM literature (Zach et al. 2010, Roberts et al. 2011, Wilson and Snavely 2013, Heinly et al. 2014) and track-level verification (COLMAP, Schonberger and Frahm 2016) engaged

evidence.correctness: Ran the full sweep in a scratch copy (/usr/bin/python3.13 experiments/run.py, 13.6 min on 4 shared cores): every row of experiments/results.txt reproduces byte-for-byte. The per-seed claims reproduce exactly (plain Cauchy span 1: eleven seeds 0.0031-0.0073 and 0.2426; gate + Cauchy span 12: 0.6431 in seed 0, median 0.0048; g_linear span 12 mean 0.0048). Independent checks: the 8-point fit on noise-free matches equals the textbook F = [e']x P' P^+ (Hartley and Zisserman eq. 9.1) to 1e-16 on pairs 0-1, 0-2, 0-3; the Sampson distance agrees with the gold-standard two-view reprojection error minimised over X by scipy to <0.001% at 1 px noise. But the realised wrong-observation share, against the analytic min(1, rV/s)*s/V, is 0.0830 at span 1 / ratio 0.8 (p = 0.102*12 = 1.22 is silently capped at 1, so every feature is wrong in exactly one view, share 1/12), not the stated 0.102; every other cell matches (0.1013-0.1021, 0.060-0.061, 0.046-0.048). The span-1, ratio-0.8 cell anchors the headline: at the true independent 10.2% near-miss case (sensing_epigate run_trial kind='near', frac=0.102, 12 seeds) gate + Cauchy is 0.0037 and RANSAC start 0.0056 (lead 1.5x, recall 0.84), not 0.0031 / 0.0052 (1.7x, 0.81). Direction holds, magnitude overstated; capped at 2.
evidence.completeness: Everything the README lists exists and runs: correlated mismatch, patched trial, sweep over 3 rates x 5 spans x 12 seeds, results.txt, figure built from results.txt (not retyped), 4 tests, the two-cell per-seed rerun (reproduced). Next steps (persistent wrong 3D point, gate + RANSAC start, measured span) are stated as not done. No stubs or TODOs.
evidence.verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /usr/bin/python3.13 -m pytest -q -> 4 passed in 7.15 s. Seeded via platform/ci/quality_mutate.py: (1) runs all start at view 0 instead of a random start (corr.py:32) SURVIVED; (2) p = frac*(V-2)/span, a 17% rate error (corr.py:25) SURVIVED; (3) offset halved (corr.py:36) caught. The rate test uses frac 0.1 where span 1 already caps, with a 0.06-0.14 band, so it cannot see the live 18% rate shortfall. No test touches the experiment script or any number in results.txt.
evidence.craft: Read src/sensing_gatecorr/corr.py (58 lines), tests/test_corr.py, experiments/run.py, experiments/figure.py. Small and readable; figure regenerated from results.txt. Defects: min(1.0, ...) at corr.py:25 is a silent clamp that changes the experiment's controlled variable without a warning; the trial is driven by monkeypatching sensing_epigate.gate.mismatch through sys.path inserts of two sibling trees (works per worker, fragile); pyproject declares numpy/scipy but not the sibling packages it imports; run.py records means only, no per-seed rows, so the heavy tails it discusses had to be rerun by hand.
evidence.claims: Checked: every number in the README table and bullets matches results.txt; rates 0.102/0.061/0.047 match sensing-matchreal/experiments/results.txt section A2; 1.7x = 0.0052/0.0031 = 1.68 and 1.06x = 0.0051/0.0048 correct; recall 0.81->0.60 and 0.82->0.61 at ratios 0.7/0.6 correct; per-seed claims correct. Not backed: README.md:11 'The expected share of wrong observations stays at the measured rate for every span (a test checks it)' and 'span = 1 is the independent near-miss case' are false at ratio 0.8 (share 0.083, and every feature has exactly one bad view, not independent draws), and the headline 1.7x / 0.0031 / recall 0.81 'at a 10% rate' rest on that cell. Limitations are honest and specific (span swept not measured, image-space offset, near-type only, 12 heavy-tailed seeds). Live page not loadable: proxy 403 for marisstella.app.
evidence.fitness: A researcher could extend it (the mismatch function is a clean drop-in), and it feeds the sensing-selfcal programme in research/PROGRAMMES.md. But it is a one-session sweep: synthetic rig, one image-space offset model whose 2D shift is nearly epipolar-consistent for adjacent views (a shared 10-40 px offset passes the 2 px Sampson gate under the true F in 74% of 30-degree pairs against 5% for a one-view offset), near-type mismatches only although sensing-matchreal measures 29% near / 39% along / 33% far at ratio 0.8, means of 12 seeds without intervals. The closest literature on correlated wrong matches from repeated structure (Zach, Klopschitz and Pollefeys CVPR 2010; Roberts et al. CVPR 2011; Wilson and Snavely ECCV 2013; Heinly et al. ECCV 2014) and track-level verification in COLMAP (Schonberger and Frahm CVPR 2016) is not cited; novelty is modest and not claimed beyond the sibling projects.
evidence.domain: Against Hartley and Zisserman ch. 11 the gate itself is correct (normalised 8-point, rank-2 projection, Sampson) and the rates are measured, not invented. Departures a SfM reviewer hits first: production pipelines verify tracks by multi-view triangulation and reprojection, not only by pairwise votes over neighbours 1-3, so the gate studied is weaker than practice; the correlated model shifts every view by the same pixel vector instead of a consistent wrong 3D point (acknowledged); the gate pairs only views 1-3 apart, the same neighbourhood the span corrupts, so span >= 4 removes every clean partner by construction and that interaction is not separated from 'correlation'; no paired statistics (a paired sign test at span 1 gives gate < RANSAC start in 12 of 12 seeds, which the README's 'cannot tell from a tie' framing never tests at span 8).

defects.what: The per-feature probability rate*12/span is silently capped at 1; at span 1 and ratio 0.8 (rate 0.102, p = 1.22) every feature is wrong in exactly one view and the realised wrong share is 1/12 = 0.083, not 0.102. The headline's span-1 anchor (gate + Cauchy 0.0031, 1.7x lead, recall 0.81 'at a 10% rate') was run at 8.3%; the genuinely independent 10.2% near case gives 0.0037, 0.0056, a 1.5x lead and recall 0.84

README states the expected wrong share 'stays at the measured rate for every span (a test checks it)' and that 'span = 1 is the independent near-miss case'; both are false at ratio 0.8, and the probability is written as rate*12/span without the min(1, .) cap

The rate test uses frac 0.1 (already capped at span 1) with a 0.06-0.14 band, so a 17% rate error and the live 18% shortfall pass; moving every run to start at view 0 also passes; no test covers run.py or any reported number

Prior work on correlated wrong matches from repeated structure (Zach et al. 2010, Roberts et al. 2011, Wilson and Snavely 2013, Heinly et al. 2014) and track-level multi-view verification (COLMAP, Schonberger and Frahm 2016) is not cited; the pairwise-vote gate is weaker than the verification real pipelines use

Headline frames the recall loss as a cost of correlation, but a pure image-space shared offset is nearly epipolar-consistent for adjacent views (passes the 2 px gate in 74% of 30-degree pairs vs 5% for a one-view offset), and the gate's pairs (offsets 1-3) sit inside the corrupted span by construction; the effect of the offset model and of the gate's neighbourhood is not separated from correlation
Means of 12 heavy-tailed seeds with no interval or paired test; run.py keeps no per-seed rows, so the tails had to be rerun by hand; 'cannot tell from a tie' is asserted, not tested

verdict: Small, clean and exactly reproducible: the full sweep re-runs byte-identically, the per-seed tail claims reproduce, the rates match sensing-matchreal, and the underlying 8-point fit and Sampson gate match Hartley and Zisserman to machine precision. But the one cell the headline is anchored on is not what the README says: at span 1 and ratio 0.8 the bad-feature probability 1.22 is silently clamped to 1, so that cell runs at 8.3% wrong, not 10.2%, while the README says the rate is held at every span and a test checks it (the test's band cannot see it). The genuinely independent 10.2% case gives a 1.5x gate lead (0.0037 vs 0.0056) and recall 0.84, not 1.7x and 0.81, so the qualitative finding (the gate's lead shrinks as mismatches repeat) survives but its size is overstated. Two of three seeded bugs survive the tests, the recall loss is partly an artefact of the pure-2D shared offset (nearly epipolar-consistent on adjacent views), and the repeated-structure SfM literature is not cited. Finished for what it claims, does not meet the bar. Overlap: it builds on sensing-gatemix, which sensing-mixgate (audited separately) duplicates almost exactly.
